description: 環島1號線數值路網圖 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 交通部運輸研究所. 103年5月行政院要求相關部會於104年底前完成自行車環島路線之串連，交通部於是結合教育部體育署、內政部營建署及各地方政府完成自行車環島1號線。 「自行車環島1號線」主線全長約968公里，在沿線適當地點均設置自行車專用標誌、標線，清楚地導引民眾進行環島騎乘，更於沿線設置122處補給站，貼心提供騎士休息與補給；其次，為考量無法一次(9天)完... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 交通部運輸研究所. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-06-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
